tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Quotient by a contractible subspace with the HEP]

↗ def:homotopy-extension-property ↗ def:contractible ↗ def:homotopy-equivalence

1. ch0:0.17\group CW Complexes

If $(X,A)$ has HEP and $A$ is contractible, then the quotient map $q:X\to X/A$ is a homotopy equivalence.

Proof

\sketch Extend a contraction of $A$ to $f_t:X\to X$ with $f_0=\one $. Since $f_t(A)\subset A$, $qf_t$ descends to $\bar f_t:X/A\to X/A$. At $t=1$, $f_1$ is constant on $A$ and induces $g:X/A\to X$ with $gq=f_1$. Thus $gq=f_1\simeq \one _X$ and $qg=\bar f_1\simeq \one _{X/A}$.

□
